title: Legibility and Contrast of Information Supplied by Manufacturer
text: All markings, symbols, and human-readable text on labels shall be legible under standard clinical ambient illumination (500 lux) at a nominal reading distance of 30 cm. High contrast between lettering and background must be maintained, and minimum text height for critical clinical specifications (e.g. dimensions, warnings) shall not be less than 1.2 mm.

title: Decimal Points and Unit Expressions
text: Critical dimensions, metric measurements, and concentrations shall clearly express the decimal point. Leading zeros before decimal fractions are mandatory (e.g. 0.5 mm, never .5 mm) and trailing decimal zeros without context should be avoided to prevent decimal shift misinterpretations.
